receipt.public_excerpt: Investing in compute is a prerequisite for long-term growth.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic reports a first-half 2026 GAAP net loss of $80.7 billion, including $72.4 billion of financing-instrument fair-value changes, so the headline loss cannot be attributed to chips. The filing also reports positive adjusted operating and adjusted net income, material qualifications to any claim that profits under every measure remain absent.

unresolved_gaps: Marcus did not specify an accounting basis or profit measure.
One company's interim results do not establish sustained industry profitability.
The evidence does not isolate chip costs as the cause of the reported net losses.
Positive adjusted results and negative GAAP results cannot be treated as interchangeable.
